678-4022-5256.notablePrerequisites: A permanent you control has left the battlefield this turn
678-4022-5256.description:
Cast Hidden Herbalists by paying its mana cost.
When Hidden Herbalists enters, it triggers, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Hidden Herbalists.
When Hidden Herbalists dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Hidden Herbalists from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing a player to mill a number of cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Repeat.

574-1981-2415-8175.description:
Activate Vish Kal by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Edgar and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Edgar trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve Vish Kal's ability, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on them equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Repeat.
574-1981-2415-8175.notes: Once Vish Kal has infinite +1/+1 counters, you may activate its last ability any number of times to reduce the toughnesses of any number of creatures to 0.

850-4091-7791.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two creatures with defender.
850-4091-7791.description:
Activate Overgrown Battlement by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}.
Activate Aphetto Alchemist by tapping it, targeting Overgrown Battlement.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Aphetto Alchemist's ability, targeting Aphetto Alchemist.
Resolve both Aphetto Alchemist abilities, untapping it and Overgrown Battlement.
Repeat.

3188-7690-7743--165.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3188-7690-7743--165.description:
Gain life.
Heroic Feast triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the other Hero.
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Social Climber triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

2104-2349-7722.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying its mana cost.
Thor's second ability triggers, dealing damage to any target.
Resolve Temporal Manipulation, causing you to take an extra turn after this one
Blink Thor using Mistmeadow Witch.
When Thor enters, it triggers, exiling Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard and allowing you to cast it from exile until the end of your next turn.
Move to your next turn.
Cast Temporal Manipulation from exile by paying its mana cost.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

997-2185-6972.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Howlgeist
When Howlgeist dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Howlgeist
When Howlgeist dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve both Woe Strider abilities from step 1 and 3.
Repeat.
997-2185-6972.notes: If Howlgeist starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 3 instead.

2438-3175-7424.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Sun Titan.
When Sun Titan dies, Changing Loyalty triggers, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning Changing Loyalty from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Sun Titan.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

3197-6996-7399.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3197-6996-7399.description:
Gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Bogwater Lumaret triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

2167-6557-7380-7385.description:
Activate Squandered Resources by sacrificing Vernal Fen, adding {G}.
Activate Floral Evoker by paying {G} and discarding Veilborn Ghoul, returning Vernal Fen from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Vernal Fen enters, Floral Evoker and Veilborn Ghoul trigger.
Resolve the Floral Evoker trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Veilborn Ghoul trigger, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1806-2060-2445-6797-7367.description:
Activate Eternal Scourge's scavenge ability, granted to it by Young Deathclaws, by paying {3} and exiling Eternal Scourge from your graveyard, putting six +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler due to Branching Evolution.
Activate Crystalline Crawler six times by removing six +1/+1 counters from it, adding {6}.
Cast Eternal Scourge from exile by paying {3}.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Eternal Scourge.
Repeat.

1169-3490-6006-7075.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that has not been tapped this turn.
1169-3490-6006-7075.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, adding {1}.
The creature's ability granted to it by Tale of Katara and Toph triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

147-5117-5147.description:
Cast Undying Malice by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, copying Undying Malice, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Undying Malice.
Holding priority, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
When Dualcaster Mage dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Goblin Bombardment abilities from step 5.

1849-4251-6911.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1849-4251-6911.description:
Declare Godo as an attacker, triggering its ability, causing you to untap it and all Samurai you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Godo, triggering Impostor Syndrome, creating a token copy of Godo that isn't legendary.
When the Godo token enters, it triggers, allowing you to search your library for an Equipment and put it onto the battlefield.
During your next combat phase, declare Godo and the Godo token as attackers.
The Godo token triggers, causing you to untap it and all Samurai you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat from step 2.

500-1777-4477.description:
Cast Saw in Half by paying {2}{B}, destroying Greenwarden of Murasa and creating two token copies of it with base power equal to half the destroyed creature's power and base toughness equal to half the destroyed creature's toughness, rounding up each time.
When the Greenwarden of Murasa tokens enter the battlefield, they trigger, returning Saw in Half and Burnt Offering from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Burnt Offering by paying {B} and sacrificing a Greenwarden of Murasa token, adding {B}{B} plus an additional amount of {B} and/or {R} equal to its mana value minus 2. 
Repeat.

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

1322-5299-5921-5970--112.notablePrerequisites:
Mirror Room is locked.
Fractured Realm is unlocked.
1322-5299-5921-5970--112.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice.
Resolve the first trigger, creating a token copy of Marina.
Put the tapped Marina into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Marina token enters the battlefield, it's first ability triggers twice, causing you to look at the top seven cards of your library and put all enchantment cards from among them into your hand and the rest on the bottom of your library, and then repeat this once.
Resolve the second Mirror Room trigger, creating a token copy of itself, as it is a creature due to Opalescence.
Activate the Marina token by tapping it, unlocking the token Mirror Room.
Repeat from step 2.
1322-5299-5921-5970--112.notes: The chosen anthem must increase the toughness of the Mirror Room token so it does not die as it enters the battlefield.

2781-5361.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Auton Soldier.
2781-5361.description:
Cast Auton Soldier by paying its mana cost, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Felidar Guardian
When Auton Soldier enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Felidar Guardian.
When Felidar Guardian enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Auton Soldier. Choose to have Auton Soldier enter the battlefield as a copy of Felidar Guardian.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with three or more charge counters on it

198-2871-4067-6571.description:
Activate Empowered Autogenerator by tapping it, putting a charge counter on it and adding {R} for each charge counter on it.
Cast Seething Anger with buyback by paying {3}{R}.
Shantotto triggers, giving it +4/+0 until end of turn and causing you to draw a card.
Resolve Seething Anger.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Empowered Autogenerator.
Repeat.

2653-5226-5531-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have at least two lands between the battlefield and your graveyard.
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn
2653-5226-5531-5702.description:
Play any land.
When the land enters the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko triggers.
Holding priority, activate Lithatog by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 3 until you control no lands.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Lumra.
Put the token Lumra into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Lumra token's enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, causing you to mill four cards and returning all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the lands enter the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko and Nissa trigger that many times.
Resolve all Nissa triggers, adding {G} for each trigger.
Resolve all but one Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating that many 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Repeat from step 3.

2034-2366-5003-6517.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Dryad Arbor, adding {C}{C}.
When Dryad Arbor dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Dryad Arbor from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attaching Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Dryad Arbor enters the battlefield, Dragonback Assault triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

5733-6308.notablePrerequisites: You control a Rogue that does not have summoning sickness and that cannot be blocked by an opponent.
5733-6308.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using a Rogue.
Cast Notorious Throng for its prowl cost by paying {5}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Conqueror's Foothold's fourth ability by paying {6} and tapping it, returning Notorious Throng from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

1636-4136-5996.easyPrerequisites: Tarmogoyf Nest does not have summoning sickness.
1636-4136-5996.notablePrerequisites: Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {1}{G}.
1636-4136-5996.description:
Activate Roaring Earth by paying {1}{G}{G} and discarding it, causing the land with Tarmogoyf Nest attached to become a creature until end of turn.
Activate any number of creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {1}{G}.
Activate the land with Tarmogoyf Nest attached by paying {1}{G} and tapping it, creating a Tarmogoyf creature token.
When the Tarmogoyf enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat from step 2.

2438-2724-3194-3582.description:
Activate Kaya the Inexorable's first ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, putting a ghostform counter on Wormfang Manta.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Wormfang Manta.
When Wormfang Manta dies, its second ability and its ghostform ability trigger.
Resolve the ghostform trigger, returning Wormfang Manta from your graveyard to your hand and creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
Resolve the second trigger, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Wormfang Manta by paying {5}{U}{U}.
Wormfang Manta's first ability does not trigger due to Hushwing Gryff.
Repeat each turn.

1335-4029-4929.notablePrerequisites:
Marath has at least two +1/+1 counters on it.
Cryptic Trilobite has at least two +1/+1 counters on it.
1335-4029-4929.description:
Activate Marath by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting two +1/+1 counters on Marath.
Activate Marath by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting two +1/+1 counters on Cryptic Trilobite.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Repeat.
Once Cryptic Trilobite has infinite +1/+1 counters, you may remove them for infinite mana, then repeat step 1 to get infinite +1/+1 counters on Marath, which can then be used for Marath's other modes.

2127-4214-5189.notablePrerequisites: A creature you control has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
2127-4214-5189.description:
Activate Ghave's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from a creature you control, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
When the Saproling enters the battlefield, Tribute to the World Tree triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on the Saproling.
Activate Ghave's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from a creature you control.
Holding priority, activate Utopia Mycon's second ability by sacrificing the Saproling, adding {1}.
Resolve the Ghave ability, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat from step 2.

1080-1494-2740-4324-5261.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Tamiyo's Journal triggers, creating a Clue artifact token.
At the beginning of your combat phase, Workshop Elders triggers, causing the Clue to become a 0/0 artifact creature token and putting four +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Bioshift without paying its mana cost, targeting the Clue that has +1/+1 counters on it and Sage of Hours.
Sage of Hours triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Resolve Bioshift, moving the four +1/+1 counters from the Clue onto Sage of Hours.
The Clue dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Activate Sage of Hours by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to take at least one extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

141-3853.manaNeeded: {2}{U}{U} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
141-3853.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one creature.
You have enough mana to cast Mirage Mockery
141-3853.description:
Cast Mirage Mockery by paying its mana cost, targeting a creature you control.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {2}{U}{U} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Naru Meha enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying Mirage Mockery, targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Mirage Mockery, creating a token copy of Naru Meha.
Put either Naru Meha into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Repeat from step 3.
141-3853.notes: You may also choose to pay Mirage Mockery's entwine cost and target an artifact creature you control, if desired.

121-856-3765.description:
Cast Cauldron Familiar by paying {B}.
When Cauldron Familiar enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, cast Worldfire by paying {6}{R}{R}{R}, exiling all permanents, all cards in all hands and graveyards, and setting each player's life total to one.
Resolve the Voldran Epicure trigger from step 2, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Each opponent loses the game due to having 0 or less life.

1981-3983-4378.notablePrerequisites:
You control an additional creature.
You have a way to cause the additional creature to die.
1981-3983-4378.description:
Cause the additional creature to die.
Sanguinary Priest triggers, dealing 1 damage to you and causing you to gain one life.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
The Soldier enters the battlefield as a 0/0 due to Night of Souls' Betrayal and dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Repeat from step 2.

2829-3363-5131.notablePrerequisites: You have not cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
2829-3363-5131.description:
Activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing The One Ring, putting a +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Ravager.
Cast The One Ring from your graveyard by paying {4}.
The One Ring triggers, giving you protection from everything until your next turn.
Repeat during each of your turns.

2034-5003-5050.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Chittering Witch, adding {C}{C}.
When Chittering Witch dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Chittering Witch from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Chittering Witch enters, it triggers, creating at least one creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.
2034-5003-5050.notes: You can make infinite creature tokens if you have two or more opponents.

2160-2647-3976.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2160-2647-3976.description:
Cast Warrior's Oath by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and to lose the game at the beginning of that turn's end step.
Activate Magar by paying {1}{B}{R}, noting Warrior's Oath and putting it face down on the battlefield as a 3/3 creature.
During your next turn, deal combat damage to an opponent using the face down creature that has Warrior's Oath noted.
The creature triggers, casting a copy of Warrior's Oath without paying its mana cost. Resolve the copy, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and to lose the game at the beginning of that turn's end step.
Activate Sundial of the Infinite by paying {1} and tapping it, causing you to end the turn. This will prevent the Warrior's Oath trigger from causing you to lose the game.
Repeat from step 3.

1000-2104-2493-3791.notablePrerequisites: {1} fewer mana required on the first turn if Mystic Reflection was foretold.
1000-2104-2493-3791.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying {3}{U}{U}, granting you an extra turn after this one.
Cast Mystic Reflection by paying {1}{U}, causing the next creatures or planeswalkers to enter the battlefield this turn to enter as copies of Archaeomancer.
Cast Hordeling Outburst by paying {1}{R}{R}, creating three token copies of Archaeomancer.
Each of the Archaeomancer's ETBs trigger, returning Mystic Reflection, Temporal Manipulation, and Hordeling Outburst to your hand.
Repeat.

2713-3493-4474.notablePrerequisites:
Paradise Mantle attached to Patrol Signaler.
Patrol Signaler does not have summoning sickness.
2713-3493-4474.description:
Tap Patrol Signaler using Paradise Mantle, generating {W}.
Activate Patrol Signaler's untap ability discounted by Zirda, generating a 1/1 white Kithkin Soldier token.
Repeat for infinite tokens.
